title: Add NamanSoni78 to the list
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
Adds NamanSoni78 to the community model publisher allowlist.

Closes #14139

gist.headline: Another gardener gets keys
gist.blurb: NamanSoni78 has been added to the community model-publisher allowlist. One more set of hands for tending the shared model garden.
gist.summary: Added NamanSoni78 to the GitHub-based allowlist for community model publishers.
gist.impact: This lets NamanSoni78 publish community models through the approved contributor flow.
gist.visual_concept: Polli welcomes a new anonymous community gardener into a cozy code-garden, handing them a small lime-green key beside a terminal that shows an approved publisher list. The scene represents contributor access rather than a new public API capability.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, giving a lime green (#ecf874) key to a friendly silhouetted community gardener beside a retro terminal showing a short approved-publisher list. Code-plants and small flowers grow from pots around them; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) details and a warm welcoming atmosphere.
